output.reason: [ev-00ae0ffe7ffa] says Compositions using `spec.mode: Resources` (native patch and transform) must be migrated to composition functions before upgrading, so a Composition with spec.mode equal to Resources is exposed. The validator's computed diff of the Composition CRDs [ev-b12db1ba30d3] [ev-a3bca45d2477] says the default of spec.mode changed between releases. The only values are Resources and Pipeline, and v2 keeps only Pipeline, so a Composition that leaves spec.mode unset probably ran in Resources mode by default on v1.20. The proposed equals-only condition is therefore too narrow. Confidence is low because the old default literal is not shown directly in any excerpt.

correction.statement: Native patch and transform composition (Composition spec.mode: Resources) is removed in Crossplane 2.0. Compositions that set spec.mode to Resources, or leave it unset and so default to Resources on v1.x, must be migrated to composition functions before upgrading.
